runs.name: Hyster-Yale, Inc.
runs.box: OUT AT Q2; integrity facts recorded, not judged
runs.entry: Price **$31.93** (close 2026-10-12, aggregator quote via `tools/run.py`, flagged). Shares **17,930,387** (Class A 14,488,232 and Class B 3,442,155 at 2026-07-31, 10-Q cover, accession 0001173514-26-000202; Class B convertible one for one with the same dividend, ten votes a share; `Screens/cover_shares.py` agrees; checked against 17,733,794 outstanding at 2025-12-31); cap **$572.5M**; net debt $427.4M at 2026-06-30, enterprise value about $999.9M. Sovereign **5.60%** (USD; US Treasury daily par yield curve, 30-year, 10/09/2026). Formerly Hyster-Yale Materials Handling, Inc. (EDGAR, to 2024-05-30); no merger or split. Filings read: 10-K FY2025 (0001173514-26-000049, Items 1, 1A, 5, 7, 8), 10-Q to 2026-06-30, DEF 14A (0001173514-26-000083), 8-Ks of 2025-11-19 (restructuring, about 575 employees) and 2026-08-06 (a COO), the 10-Ks FY2016 to FY2024 for segments and the 2021 inflation narrative; one figure cross-checked: FY2025 operating cash $86.1M on the filed cash-flow statement equals the XBRL figure. Lines of evidence derived by the analyst from Items 1, 1A and 7 and stated in the run file. Competitors: the 10-K names no rival and no lift-truck maker files with the SEC; Jungheinrich (FY2016 to FY2024) and KION (FY2016 to FY2025) read from their own annual reports, flagged as not SEC filings; Toyota Industries, Mitsubishi Logisnext and the Chinese makers not obtained, Crown private. **Q1 IN**: lift trucks, parts and attachments through independent dealers, readable over ten years of segment filings; Americas $646.6M of the company's $240.0M five-year operating profit decides (EMEA, JAPIC and Nuvera lost money, Bolzoni $29.1M). **Q2 OUT**: the deciding part's castle protects only ordinary returns over a full cycle: Americas operating margin 4.8% FY2016 to FY2025 with headquarters inside it, company 1.5% with losses in 2021, 2022 and 2025, against Jungheinrich 7.5% EBIT and KION 6.0%; in 2021 Americas absorbed $107.5M of material and freight inflation net of $22.1M of price increases and went from a $102.1M profit to a $19.7M loss; about $100M of 2025 tariff cost not expected to be fully offset in 2026; the filer says rivals "may have lower manufacturing costs" and "compete aggressively with lower-priced value and standard products". Q3 to Q12 not reached. COMPUTATION, NOT A CLEARANCE: owner cash on the FY2016 to FY2025 cycle base (2021 aberrational), organic, all spending, working capital counted, $7.9M a year equity-only, $25.1M all-equity (interest added back at 21%, a CONVENTION of the run); purchases deducted minus $13.2M; the literal five-year window negative; the series changes sign, so the no-growth case alone; range **$1.12 to $1.37 a share** all-equity ($7.89 to $8.14 equity-only) against $31.93; no case earns the floor (central about 2.5% on enterprise value); fair **not positive all-equity (minus $9.79)**, $4.49 equity-only; beside it, not a case, the peak years 2023 and 2024 would give about $43 all-equity; no alert (box not OUT at Q7). Balance sheets, ten years: book equity $463.8M (2016) to $472.0M (2025); dividends $216.8M against $160.0M of net income; debt about $290M to $500M, 55% of capitalisation; JAPIC goodwill (Maximal, 2018) impaired $55.6M in 2021; a $165.9M valuation allowance against $187.7M of deferred tax assets. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: a published 2026 outlook and a "long-term objective of achieving approximately 7% operating profit over the business cycle" the decade has not met; the Rankin and Taplin families hold 94.29% of Class B; restructuring charges in 2024 and 2025 and a new program; buyback prices not read against a range. Contamination declared by the analyst: the HTCMY commit subjects in the session's opening context; nothing blind-listed opened. Commits 482c4b2e, 33302c59, b948bd51, 6b653813. Citations: the analyst's check passed; the dispatcher's script (`_verify_cites.py`) 15 quotation pairs, no slip, no E-id. Position note filled at the fold (not held). check_framework PASS. **For the operator:** the analyst's gaps: (1) whether a rival's own non-SEC annual report counts as "their own filings" where no rival files with the SEC, and IFRS EBIT against US GAAP operating profit; (2) the parts threshold where the company's total is below the deciding part's; (3) a segment that carries headquarters costs; (4) the fair price's "two ends" when the range is the no-growth case alone (the all-spending and maintenance variants used); (5) no stated tax rate for the all-equity interest add-back. Could not get: Toyota Industries, Mitsubishi Logisnext and Chinese rivals' figures, the earnings-release exhibits (no check for a featured adjusted figure).
runs.narr: Q2 OUT: a maker of Hyster and Yale lift trucks, parts and Bolzoni attachments sold through independent dealers (formerly Hyster-Yale Materials Handling, Inc.) whose deciding Americas part earns only ordinary returns over a full cycle, operating margin 4.8% FY2016 to FY2025 and the company 1.5% against Jungheinrich 7.5% and KION 6.0%, the 2021 inflation not passed through, rivals with lower costs in the filer's own words. COMPUTATION beneath the stop: range $1.12 to $1.37 a share all-equity against $31.93, no case earns the floor; fair not positive all-equity ($4.49 equity-only), not armed. After the stop, integrity facts recorded, not judged: a published outlook and a 7% through-cycle margin objective the decade has not met; family control through ten-vote Class B.
